oradourvillage.name: Oradour-sur-Glane
oradourvillage.slogan: A whole village left standing as it fell, rust and rooftops.
oradourvillage.line: Of the village destroyed on 10 June 1944, 642 people were killed; on de Gaulle's orders the ruins were kept as a permanent memorial.

limogesdubouche.name: Adrien Dubouché Museum
limogesdubouche.slogan: Fine porcelain, from white clay to a dinner service for kings.
limogesdubouche.line: Nationalised in 1881, the museum holds almost 18,000 works in ceramics and glass, with the world's richest public collection of Limoges porcelain.

limogesbenedictins.name: Gare des Bénédictins
limogesbenedictins.slogan: A railway station crowned like a cathedral, with a copper dome.
limogesbenedictins.line: Designed by Roger Gonthier and opened on 2 July 1929, its clock tower rises about 67 metres over thirteen levels.

citebdangouleme.name: Cité de la BD, Angoulême
citebdangouleme.slogan: Speech bubbles, inked boards and a town that lives for comics.
citebdangouleme.line: Announced in 1984 by culture minister Jack Lang, it houses the only museum in France labelled Musée de France for comics.

limogescathedral.name: Limoges Cathedral
limogescathedral.slogan: Gothic stone climbing slowly, from 1273 to 1888.
limogescathedral.line: Its Flamboyant north portal was carved between 1516 and 1530, and the Renaissance rood screen shows the Labours of Hercules.
